title: Spaghetti mit Fluffigem Fuss
description: A German twist on a classic spaghetti dish, incorporating fluffy ingredients. Simple and quick to make.

ingredients.name: kenyan
ingredients.notes: kenyan spice blend for added flavor

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the spaghetti according to package instructions until al dente.
In a pan, heat the kissed oil over medium heat.
Add the kenyan spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the fluffy ingredient and cook for 2 minutes.
Combine the cooked spaghetti and oil mixture.
